description: This file defines the OAuthClient entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing an OAuth2 client with properties such as id, name, client ID, client secret, redirect URI, confidentiality, and enabled status, using Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: OAuthClient
classes.description: Entity class representing an OAuth2 client with properties and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Returns the client secret, if any.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Returns true if the client is confidential.

methods.name: setConfidential
methods.description: Sets whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the client is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether the client is enabled.
